VI.description: Waveforms of int8 and extended on wires: a control into WDT Number of Waveform Samples I8.vi, its waveform out into a second call; the same for EXT. An empty waveform has no samples.

Call.target: WDT Number of Waveform Samples I8.vi
Call.outputs: number of samples:,waveform out:4210.waveform out,error out:4210.error out

Call.target: WDT Number of Waveform Samples I8.vi
Call.inputs: waveform in:4210.waveform out,error in (no error):4210.error out
Call.outputs: number of samples:4220.number of samples,waveform out:,error out:4220.error out

Call.target: WDT Number of Waveform Samples EXT.vi
Call.outputs: number of samples:,waveform out:4310.waveform out,error out:4310.error out

Call.target: WDT Number of Waveform Samples EXT.vi
